source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper constructs robust mean and variance procedures with observable deviation control under variance and kurtosis hypotheses; it is a scalar calibration template rather than a theorem about marked factorial statistics.
The paper establishes Cramer-type moderate deviations for self-normalized processes, including Studentized U-statistics, under its stated fixed-kernel framework.

The paper gives confidence intervals for probabilities of unseen multinomial events and a large-alphabet simultaneous-inference construction, not an overlap-coupled causal aggregate with outcome marks.

The paper develops lower bounds for expected length of confidence intervals for linear functionals through between-class moduli and constructs constant-factor adaptive procedures in Gaussian nonparametric models.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper derives finite-sample optimal ATE estimators and confidence intervals under unconfoundedness with smoothness/shape restrictions and normal known-variance errors, with feasible asymptotic extensions when errors are unknown.
